title: 4.3 Where Things Are
unit_outcome: Talk about your home, where things are, your morning, what you do at home, the days, the time and the months in Spanish.
goal: Say where things are with en, sobre, debajo de and al lado de.
grammar_function: Thing + está + en/sobre/debajo de/al lado de + place (de + el = del).
speaking_outcome: Say where things are with en, sobre, debajo de and al lado de.
